policy: Never copy an AE binary into a Premiere or Resolve plugin folder. Original vendor licenses and supported host builds are required.

effects.premiere: transparent ProRes graphics or AE-generated MOGRT

effects.resolve: TextPlus setting for basic editable text; transparent graphics for full animation

effects.browser: backdrop blur, tint, gradient, rim; approximate optical material
effects.premiere: transparent graphics; optical blur of underlying host footage is not reproduced
effects.resolve: transparent graphics; native optical material requires a separate Fusion implementation

effects.browser: shared surface, continuous dividers, alignment, animated size

effects.id: AE Glass / Glassary / Orb Reactor / Cosmic / TextBox / Textyle / Animation Composer
